concerns.text: Unit test T020a (`test_binning_logic`) is placed before the producer task T020c (`assign_shape_bin`) that implements the binning function it tests, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Robustness Validation & Sensitivity Analysis – T028
concerns.text: Unit test T028 (`test_sensitivity_sweep`) is scheduled before the implementation task T030 (`run_sweep`) that provides the sweep function it tests, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
